package.name: bonbon_human_ai_bringup
package.description: Pi-2 bringup: composes the existing per-subsystem launch files (HAL camera/mic/speaker, ASR/VAD, local LLM, face recognition via vision, multi-person tracking, object intelligence, gesture, affective AI, human state fusion, TTS, speaker intelligence) into ONE launch for the Human AI Pi, in the boot order specified by config/distributed/pi_human_ai.yaml. Launches ONLY Pi-2 hardware (camera/mic/speaker) -- explicitly disables lidar/servo/estop/battery so this launch can never accidentally start Pi-3 hardware nodes on Pi-2, per docs/DISTRIBUTED_DEPLOYMENT_BLOCKERS.md Blocker 2. This package launches no nodes of its own -- it is composition only.
